help.label: Help on the split by age
help.title: What the split shows
help.body: The split shows how long an amount has been outstanding. It is a view, not a deadline: it changes neither the total nor the match against 1100.

boundaries.note: This is a view, not a deadline. The total and the match against 1100 do not change.

asOfBanner.text: As of {date}. Payments after this date do not count.

mismatch.title: The open items and account 1100 differ by {difference}.
mismatch.body: The list shows {list}, the account shows {ledger}.

cause.direct: An entry posted straight to 1100 that belongs to no invoice and no payment.
cause.document: An invoice on 1100 whose document changed after it was posted.
cause.fxSkonto: A foreign-currency invoice settled with a cash discount can differ by one Rappen.

nothingOpen.title: Everything is settled, no open items.
nothingOpen.hint: An invoice appears here once it is issued and still unpaid.

filtered.title: No open items match this selection.
filtered.hint: Reset the selection to see every open item again.

error.transport: Open items could not be loaded.

permissionDenied.read: You do not have permission to view open items.
permissionDenied.write: You do not have permission to change the split by age.

boundaries.empty: You need at least one boundary.
boundaries.positive: The boundaries must be whole numbers above zero.
boundaries.increasing: Each boundary must be larger than the one before it.
boundaries.max: More than six periods get hard to read.

OpenItems.title: Open items
OpenItems.body: The open-items list shows which invoices are unpaid or partly paid, with due dates and ageing. It derives from the invoices you issued and the payments you recorded; you never maintain it by hand. If you account on agreed consideration, the VAT on these items is already owed, even while the money is outstanding.
